events.title: Behind the Works: Race Logic
events.summary: WORKS: Motorsport Factory is a game that turns it's back on the track. There are so many amazing racing or trackside management games out there that we didn't even want to approach the subject. But, despite never going to the race it's one of our most complex systems. This game wouldn't function without race logic. If you as a player put your whole attention into fabricating a new suspension to gain an extra 10% performance you should be rewarded for that gain. events.title: How it Works #2: Parts and Repairs
events.summary: Every racecar is made up of parts. Each part is a physical object in the game. Every mile run and every knock are recorded in it's history and it can definitely get complicated when you're chasing peak performance or endurance. Last guide we covered designing, manufacturing and testing parts for the cars in your factory.
